# %SITE_NAME%

> 统一 LLM 网关：为 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等编程客户端提供 OpenAI Responses、OpenAI Chat Completions、Anthropic Messages 三套协议的统一 base_url。

## Endpoints

- [OpenAI Responses](%PUBLIC_SITE_URL%/endpoints): `/v1` — Codex CLI / openai SDK (responses)
- [OpenAI Chat Completions](%PUBLIC_SITE_URL%/endpoints): `/v1` — 经典 /chat/completions，兼容大多数 OpenAI SDK
- [Anthropic Messages](%PUBLIC_SITE_URL%/endpoints): `/anthropic/v1` — Claude Code / anthropic SDK

## Docs

- [Home](%PUBLIC_SITE_URL%/): 接入说明
- [Models](%PUBLIC_SITE_URL%/models): 可用模型与单价
- [Endpoints](%PUBLIC_SITE_URL%/endpoints): 客户端配置示例 (Codex / Claude Code / openai-py)
- [Status](%PUBLIC_SITE_URL%/status): 服务可用性

## Optional

- API key prefix: `sk-juc-`
- Auth header: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` 或 `x-api-key: <key>`
